package student

import (
	"bytes"
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"reflect"
	"strings"
	"time"

	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/domain"
	"github.com/google/uuid"
)

func buildRuntimeTaskSnapshotFromPart(current partRuntimeContext, access domain.MilestoneAccess) (*domain.RuntimeTaskSnapshot, error) {
	runtimePlan, err := buildPartRuntimePlan(current)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	description := strings.TrimSpace(derefString(current.part.Description))
	if description == "" {
		description = current.runtimeContext.PracticeTask.Theme
	}
	activeMilestones := current.partMilestones
	if current.build != nil && len(current.build.Milestones) > 0 {
		activeMilestones = make([]domain.PracticeTaskRuntimeMilestone, 0, len(current.build.Milestones))
		for _, preview := range current.build.Milestones {
			activeMilestones = append(activeMilestones, preview.Milestone)
		}
	}
	if len(activeMilestones) > 0 {
		lines := make([]string, 0, len(activeMilestones))
		for _, milestone := range activeMilestones {
			line := milestone.Title
			if acceptance := extractAcceptanceChecklist(milestone.AcceptanceCriteriaJSON); len(acceptance) > 0 {
				line += ": " + strings.Join(acceptance, ", ")
			}
			lines = append(lines, line)
		}
		if len(lines) > 0 {
			description += "\n\nMilestones:\n- " + strings.Join(lines, "\n- ")
		}
	}
	learningTargets := []domain.LearningTargetRef{}
	if len(activeMilestones) == 1 {
		learningTargets, err = domain.NormalizeLearningTargetRefs(activeMilestones[0].LearningTargets)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
	} else if len(activeMilestones) > 1 {
		return nil, domain.ErrValidation
	}

	studentMilestoneIDs := make([]string, 0, len(activeMilestones))
	partMilestoneIDs := make([]string, 0, len(activeMilestones))
	for _, milestone := range activeMilestones {
		partMilestoneIDs = append(partMilestoneIDs, milestone.ID)
		if studentMilestone, ok := current.studentMilestonesByPartMilestoneID[milestone.ID]; ok {
			studentMilestoneIDs = append(studentMilestoneIDs, studentMilestone.ID)
		}
	}

	return &domain.RuntimeTaskSnapshot{
		ID:                     current.studentPracticeTask.WorkspaceTaskID,
		LessonID:               current.studentPracticeTask.WorkspaceLessonID,
		CourseID:               current.runtimeContext.PracticeTask.ID,
		PracticeTaskPartID:     current.part.ID,
		StudentMilestoneIDs:    studentMilestoneIDs,
		PartMilestoneIDs:       partMilestoneIDs,
		Title:                  current.part.Title,
		Description:            description,
		LearningTargets:        learningTargets,
		Status:                 domain.TaskStatusActive,
		Type:                   practiceTaskTaskTypePracticeTaskMilestone,
		TaskKind:               practiceTaskTaskKindPart,
		CodeStructureTypeCode:  runtimePlan.CodeStructureTypeCode,
		CodeStructure:          runtimePlan.ContractJSON,
		ComposeConfig:          runtimePlan.ComposeConfig,
		ExecutionMode:          taskExecutionModeBrowserPreview,
		EvaluationMode:         taskEvaluationModeAuto,
		UIMode:                 taskUIModePreview,
		SubmissionMode:         taskSubmissionModeSnapshot,
		RequiresSandbox:        true,
		ExposesPreview:         true,
		ExposesTerminal:        false,
		SupportsLiveValidation: true,
		AllowedErrorsCount:     0,
		Access:                 access,
	}, nil
}

func buildPartRuntimePlan(current partRuntimeContext) (milestoneRuntimePlan, error) {
	if current.build == nil || len(current.build.Milestones) == 0 {
		return milestoneRuntimePlan{}, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	contractJSON, err := json.Marshal(current.build.Contract)
	if err != nil {
		return milestoneRuntimePlan{}, err
	}
	firstMilestone := current.build.Milestones[0].Milestone
	codeStructureTypeCode, composeConfig, err := milestoneRuntimeProfile(firstMilestone)
	if err != nil {
		return milestoneRuntimePlan{}, err
	}
	for _, preview := range current.build.Milestones[1:] {
		otherCode, otherCompose, profileErr := milestoneRuntimeProfile(preview.Milestone)
		if profileErr != nil {
			return milestoneRuntimePlan{}, profileErr
		}
		if otherCode != codeStructureTypeCode || !jsonBytesEqual(otherCompose, composeConfig) {
			return milestoneRuntimePlan{}, domain.ErrValidation
		}
	}
	return milestoneRuntimePlan{
		TaskID:                milestoneRuntimeTaskID(current.part.ID),
		CodeStructureTypeCode: codeStructureTypeCode,
		ComposeConfig:         composeConfig,
		ContractJSON:          contractJSON,
	}, nil
}

func jsonBytesEqual(left, right json.RawMessage) bool {
	var leftValue any
	var rightValue any
	if json.Unmarshal(left, &leftValue) != nil || json.Unmarshal(right, &rightValue) != nil {
		return false
	}
	return reflect.DeepEqual(leftValue, rightValue)
}

func (useCase StudentUseCase) seedMissingPartStarterFiles(ctx context.Context, current *partRuntimeContext, sandbox *domain.SandboxSession) error {
	if useCase.Sandbox == nil || sandbox == nil || current == nil || current.build == nil {
		return nil
	}
	files, err := useCase.Sandbox.GetSnapshot(ctx, sandbox.SandboxID)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	existing := map[string]struct{}{}
	for _, file := range files {
		existing[file.Path] = struct{}{}
	}
	for _, file := range current.build.Starter.Files {
		if _, ok := existing[file.Path]; ok {
			continue
		}
		if err := useCase.Sandbox.CreateFile(ctx, sandbox.SandboxID, current.studentPracticeTask.StudentID, file.Path, file.Content); err != nil {
			return err
		}
	}
	return nil
}

func (useCase StudentUseCase) finalizeRuntimePartAnswer(
	ctx context.Context,
	binding *domain.StudentPracticeTaskTaskBinding,
	snapshot domain.RuntimeTaskSnapshot,
	input domain.RuntimeFinalizeInput,
) error {
	project, err := useCase.Students.GetStudentPracticeTask(ctx, binding.StudentPracticeTaskID)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	milestones, err := useCase.Students.ListStudentPracticeTaskMilestones(ctx, binding.StudentPracticeTaskID)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}

	milestonesByID := map[string]domain.StudentPracticeTaskMilestone{}
	for _, item := range milestones {
		milestonesByID[item.ID] = item
	}

	perMilestoneResults, rawByPartMilestoneID, err := splitPartValidationResult(input.RawResult)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}

	now := time.Now().UTC()
	alreadyFinalizedPart := true
	for _, studentMilestoneID := range snapshot.StudentMilestoneIDs {
		currentMilestone, ok := milestonesByID[studentMilestoneID]
		if !ok {
			continue
		}
		subset, hasSubset := perMilestoneResults[currentMilestone.PracticeTaskPartMilestoneID]
		alreadyFinalizedForAnswer := currentMilestone.TaskAnswerID != nil &&
			*currentMilestone.TaskAnswerID == input.AnswerID &&
			isFinalizedMilestoneStatus(currentMilestone.Status) &&
			len(bytes.TrimSpace(currentMilestone.BestResultJSON)) > 0
		if !alreadyFinalizedForAnswer {
			alreadyFinalizedPart = false
		}

		currentMilestone.TaskAnswerID = &input.AnswerID
		currentMilestone.UpdatedAt = now
		if input.SandboxID != nil {
			currentMilestone.SandboxID = input.SandboxID
		}
		if hasSubset && !alreadyFinalizedForAnswer && validationResultHasActivity(subset) {
			currentMilestone.AttemptsCount++
		}
		if rawSubset, ok := rawByPartMilestoneID[currentMilestone.PracticeTaskPartMilestoneID]; ok && len(rawSubset) > 0 {
			currentMilestone.BestResultJSON = rawSubset
		}
		switch {
		case hasSubset && validationSubsetPassed(subset):
			currentMilestone.Status = domain.StudentMilestoneStatusPassed
			currentMilestone.PassedAt = &now
		case hasSubset && validationResultHasHardFailure(subset):
			currentMilestone.Status = domain.StudentMilestoneStatusFailed
			currentMilestone.PassedAt = nil
		case currentMilestone.Status != domain.StudentMilestoneStatusPassed && currentMilestone.Status != domain.StudentMilestoneStatusSkipped:
			currentMilestone.Status = domain.StudentMilestoneStatusInProgress
			currentMilestone.PassedAt = nil
		}
		if err := useCase.Students.UpdateStudentPracticeTaskMilestone(ctx, currentMilestone); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		milestonesByID[currentMilestone.ID] = currentMilestone
	}

	project.UpdatedAt = now
	project.CurrentTaskAnswerID = &input.AnswerID
	if input.SandboxID != nil {
		project.ActiveSandboxID = input.SandboxID
	}
	if input.PreviewURL != nil {
		project.PreviewURL = input.PreviewURL
	}
	if err := useCase.Students.UpdateStudentPracticeTask(ctx, *project); err != nil {
		return err
	}

	if !alreadyFinalizedPart && input.FileStorageID != nil && *input.FileStorageID != "" {
		metaJSON, _ := json.Marshal(map[string]any{
			"task_answer_id":        input.AnswerID,
			"practice_task_part_id": snapshot.PracticeTaskPartID,
			"student_milestone_ids": snapshot.StudentMilestoneIDs,
			"part_milestone_ids":    snapshot.PartMilestoneIDs,
			"status":                input.Status,
		})
		artifact := domain.StudentPracticeTaskArtifact{
			ID:                    uuid.NewString(),
			StudentPracticeTaskID: project.ID,
			ArtifactType:          "task_answer_submission",
			StorageFileID:         *input.FileStorageID,
			PreviewURL:            input.PreviewURL,
			MetaJSON:              metaJSON,
			CreatedAt:             now,
		}
		if err := useCase.Students.CreateArtifact(ctx, artifact); err != nil {
			return err
		}
	}

	allMilestones := make([]domain.StudentPracticeTaskMilestone, 0, len(milestonesByID))
	for _, item := range milestonesByID {
		allMilestones = append(allMilestones, item)
	}
	if allMilestonesCompleted(allMilestones) {
		if err := useCase.advanceProjectAfterRuntimePass(ctx, project, "", now); err != nil {
			return err
		}
	}
	return nil
}

func splitPartValidationResult(raw json.RawMessage) (map[string]domain.ValidationRunResult, map[string]json.RawMessage, error) {
	result := map[string]domain.ValidationRunResult{}
	rawByMilestoneID := map[string]json.RawMessage{}
	trimmed := bytes.TrimSpace(raw)
	if len(trimmed) == 0 || bytes.Equal(trimmed, []byte("null")) || bytes.Equal(trimmed, []byte("{}")) {
		return result, rawByMilestoneID, nil
	}

	var envelope struct {
		ValidationReport json.RawMessage `json:"validation_report"`
	}
	if err := json.Unmarshal(trimmed, &envelope); err == nil && len(bytes.TrimSpace(envelope.ValidationReport)) > 0 {
		trimmed = bytes.TrimSpace(envelope.ValidationReport)
	}

	var aggregated domain.ValidationRunResult
	if err := json.Unmarshal(trimmed, &aggregated); err != nil {
		return nil, nil, err
	}

	ensureBucket := func(milestoneID string) *domain.ValidationRunResult {
		item, ok := result[milestoneID]
		if ok {
			return &item
		}
		item = domain.ValidationRunResult{
			ContractKind:    aggregated.ContractKind,
			ContractVersion: aggregated.ContractVersion,
			Legacy:          aggregated.Legacy,
			Stages:          []domain.ValidationStageRun{},
			Links:           []domain.ValidationLinkRun{},
			Errors:          []domain.ValidationRunIssue{},
		}
		result[milestoneID] = item
		return &item
	}

	for _, stage := range aggregated.Stages {
		milestoneID, localStageID, ok := splitPrefixedPartStageID(stage.StageID)
		if !ok {
			continue
		}
		bucket := ensureBucket(milestoneID)
		stageCopy := stage
		stageCopy.StageID = localStageID
		stageCopy.Errors = stripPrefixedValidationIssues(stageCopy.Errors)
		stageCopy.Warnings = stripPrefixedValidationIssues(stageCopy.Warnings)
		bucket.Stages = append(bucket.Stages, stageCopy)
		result[milestoneID] = *bucket
	}

	for _, link := range aggregated.Links {
		milestoneID, localLinkID, ok := splitPrefixedPartStageID(link.LinkID)
		if !ok {
			continue
		}
		bucket := ensureBucket(milestoneID)
		linkCopy := link
		linkCopy.LinkID = localLinkID
		linkCopy.Errors = stripPrefixedValidationIssues(linkCopy.Errors)
		bucket.Links = append(bucket.Links, linkCopy)
		result[milestoneID] = *bucket
	}

	for _, issue := range aggregated.Errors {
		milestoneID, localStageID, ok := splitPrefixedPartStageID(issue.StageID)
		if !ok {
			continue
		}
		bucket := ensureBucket(milestoneID)
		issueCopy := issue
		issueCopy.StageID = localStageID
		bucket.Errors = append(bucket.Errors, issueCopy)
		result[milestoneID] = *bucket
	}

	for milestoneID, bucket := range result {
		bucket.Passed = validationSubsetPassed(bucket)
		rawBucket, err := json.Marshal(bucket)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, nil, err
		}
		result[milestoneID] = bucket
		rawByMilestoneID[milestoneID] = rawBucket
	}

	return result, rawByMilestoneID, nil
}

func stripPrefixedValidationIssues(issues []domain.ValidationRunIssue) []domain.ValidationRunIssue {
	if len(issues) == 0 {
		return nil
	}
	result := make([]domain.ValidationRunIssue, 0, len(issues))
	for _, issue := range issues {
		issueCopy := issue
		if _, localStageID, ok := splitPrefixedPartStageID(issueCopy.StageID); ok {
			issueCopy.StageID = localStageID
		}
		result = append(result, issueCopy)
	}
	return result
}

func validationSubsetPassed(result domain.ValidationRunResult) bool {
	if len(result.Errors) > 0 {
		return false
	}
	hasChecks := false
	for _, stage := range result.Stages {
		if stage.Optional {
			continue
		}
		hasChecks = true
		if !stage.Passed {
			return false
		}
	}
	for _, link := range result.Links {
		if link.Optional {
			continue
		}
		hasChecks = true
		if !link.Passed {
			return false
		}
	}
	if !hasChecks {
		return result.Passed
	}
	return true
}

func validationResultHasHardFailure(result domain.ValidationRunResult) bool {
	if len(result.Errors) > 0 {
		return true
	}
	for _, stage := range result.Stages {
		if len(stage.Errors) > 0 {
			return true
		}
		if stage.Passed || stage.Optional {
			continue
		}
		switch strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(stage.Status)) {
		case "", "passed", "ok", "success", "skipped", "blocked", "pending", "waiting", "not_run":
			continue
		default:
			return true
		}
	}
	for _, link := range result.Links {
		if len(link.Errors) > 0 {
			return true
		}
		if link.Passed || link.Optional {
			continue
		}
		switch strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(link.Status)) {
		case "", "passed", "ok", "success", "skipped", "blocked", "pending", "waiting", "not_run":
			continue
		default:
			return true
		}
	}
	return false
}
